text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: All the fans were cheering for me and had big smiles on their faces!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: It was almost like the stands were a garden full of blooming flowers!
choice_data_list: It's because your running was amazing!
Let's make them bloom next time, too!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Heehee. I'm happy to have made you proud, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I'm counting on you to help me keep up with my training so that I can repeat that kind of performance!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Right! I'll do my best to bring joy to everyone!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: All right, I've got to get back into my training starting tomorrow!
